title: Navy to procure 30 robotic ships at an average cost of $40M per vessel
summary: The announcement comes less than a week after the service established a Robotic and Autonomous Systems Warfighting Development Center that’s expected to play a major role in shaping how the sea service fights with uncrewed platforms.
